items.title: Question about reading public listings on SpeedyApply INTL (personal final-year project)
items.description:
Hello SpeedyApply INTL team,

I'm Manuchehr Qoriev, a computer science student. OmniLadders (https://omniladders.pages.dev) is my own personal final-year project, free and non-commercial, and not run by any university or organization. It helps students around the world find internships and graduate roles.

My script already reads your public job listings, normally once a day, and I would like to check that this is OK with you. For each job the site shows the title, employer, location and a link to the job, and the date where your list gives one, plus a few things derived from the advert (tags, a visa note, a fit score). The same list is also a public file anyone can download. Nothing is sold. Neither this repository nor speedyapply/2027-AI-College-Jobs has a licence file, so I am asking rather than assuming, and I would be glad to credit it with a link back.

Could you tell me if this is fine, or what you would prefer (a lower rate, an API or feed, only some fields)? If someone else handles this, please forward it.

If you would rather I stop, tell me. I will block it within a few days, so that from the next daily run after that there are no more requests and your listings leave the site, and I will delete the advert text I stored.

Thank you,
Manuchehr Qoriev
OmniLadders · omniladders@gmail.com · https://omniladders.pages.dev

Technical details, in case someone asks:
- Requests, once a day (4 in all; a failed request is retried at most twice):
    GET raw.githubusercontent.com/speedyapply/2027-SWE-College-Jobs/main/INTERN_INTL.md (the international internship list)
    GET raw.githubusercontent.com/speedyapply/2027-SWE-College-Jobs/main/NEW_GRAD_INTL.md (the international new-grad list)
    GET raw.githubusercontent.com/speedyapply/2027-AI-College-Jobs/main/INTERN_INTL.md (the international AI internship list)
    GET raw.githubusercontent.com/speedyapply/2027-AI-College-Jobs/main/NEW_GRAD_INTL.md (the international AI new-grad list)
  They send the headers of Chrome on macOS; I can switch to "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; OmniLadders/1.0; +https://omniladders.pages.dev)" if you prefer.
- Link check: once a day, a HEAD request to the link of each job shown on the site (your job page or, where a listing provides one, the employer's own application page), following redirects (plus a GET on 403, 404, 405, 410 or a server error), as "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; OmniLadders/1.0; +https://omniladders.pages.dev)".
- Stored privately: the advert text, where your site provides it, used to work out labels (visa, degree, experience, language); not published in full. An occasional manual check may send, at most, a job's title, employer, location, link and up to about 2,000 characters of its text to a third-party AI service (Google Gemini or OpenAI).
- Published: title, employer, location, date, salary if given, a few tags derived from the advert, a visa note, a computed fit score and a link (also as https://omniladders.pages.dev/jobs.json), plus a short quote where an advert states a visa, experience or language requirement.

items.title: LINE Pay Vietnam - Backend Engineer - Saigon, District 10
items.description:
## Location

* District 10, HCMC, Vietnam


## Summary
- We are looking for a Mid/Senior Backend Engineer to design, build, maintain, and improve large-scale backend services. The role involves working on distributed systems that support user-facing products, business operations, partner integrations, and mission-critical transaction flows.
- You will collaborate with product, QA, operations, and overseas engineering teams to deliver reliable backend features, improve system performance, and support production stability.

### Responsibilities

- Design, develop, maintain, and enhance backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
- Build and operate scalable APIs and service-to-service integrations for user- facing and internal business systems.
- Work with distributed system components such as relational databases, message queues, caches, search platforms, and file/object storage.
- Participate in designing reliable workflows for business-critical operations such as transaction processing, asynchronous events, data synchronization, reporting, and reconciliation.
- Investigate and resolve production issues across APIs, background jobs, messaging systems, caches, databases, and external integrations.
- Improve system reliability, performance, scalability, observability, and maintainability.
- Write clean, testable, maintainable code and participate in code reviews.
- Collaborate with cross-functional and international teams to clarify requirements, design solutions, and deliver features safely.
- Contribute to technical documentation, runbooks, onboarding materials, and operational knowledge sharing.

### Requirements
- Over 5 years of experience in backend development, preferably with large-scale or distributed systems.
- Strong proficiency in Java and hands-on experience with Spring Boot.
- Solid experience designing, implementing, and maintaining RESTful APIs and
backend services.
- Experience with relational databases such as MySQL, including basic schema design, query optimization, transaction handling, and data consistency.
- Experience with Kafka or similar messaging systems, including asynchronous processing, producer/consumer patterns, retry handling, and idempotency.
- Experience with Redis or similar caching systems for caching, temporary state management, distributed locking, or rate limiting.
- Familiarity with Elasticsearch or other search/indexing platforms is a plus.
- Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud/container- based deployment is a plus.
- Understanding of system reliability topics such as logging, monitoring, tracing, alerting, performance tuning, and incident investigation.
- Strong understanding of testing practices, code review, maintainability, secure coding, and production-safe rollout.
- Good communication skills and willingness to work with international stakeholders.


### Preferred Qualification
- Experience in payment, fintech, e-commerce, order management, settlement, coupon/voucher, or other transaction-heavy systems.
- Experience designing high-consistency workflows such as checkout, payment, refund, inventory, reconciliation, or asynchronous fulfillment.
- Experience operating scheduled jobs, batch processing, retry workflows, and incident recovery procedures.
- Experience with API gateways, authentication/authorization, or secure service-to- service communication.
- Experience with object storage, file export/import workflows, or reporting systems.
- Ability to document architecture clearly, including service boundaries, API contracts, data ownership, operational runbooks, and failure scenarios.


### Contact

Send your CV to email: tungnt@linecorp.com

A AYAN é parceira oficial da Turing, empresa que conecta profissionais técnicos aos principais laboratórios de IA do mundo. Estamos selecionando engenheiros(as) de software sênior com olhar apurado para qualidade, para ajudar a definir como modelos de IA de fronteira são treinados.

## Descrição da vaga

Você vai criar e refinar rubricas para dados de preferência, revisar dados com um padrão de qualidade muito alto e construir os pipelines que geram e avaliam dados para um laboratório de IA líder.

## Local

100% remoto, **somente para quem mora nos EUA (estados aprovados) ou no Canadá**.

**Obrigatórios:**

- 5+ anos de Python (pipelines e infraestrutura) ou TypeScript / Golang / JavaScript (bases de código grandes, como o VSCode, são um diferencial)
- Experiência prática com coleta de dados de preferência e/ou criação de rubricas
- Histórico em empresas e universidades Tier 1
- Escrita técnica clara e objetiva
- Perfil do LinkedIn no currículo
- 20+ horas/semana (mínimo de 4h/dia) com 4h de overlap com o horário do Pacífico (PST)
- Inglês fluente

## Benefícios

- Trabalho 100% remoto
- Trabalho direto com um laboratório de IA de fronteira

## Contratação

Contrato de prestação de serviços (contractor), 3 meses, início imediato. 200 vagas. Processo rápido: entrevista com IA, desafio de código e uma entrevista de 30 minutos.

Preencha o formulário: https://tally.so/r/MeBXeM

### Nível

- Sênior

### Regime

- Contrato

- Remoto

items.title: Does a remote job board with limited free access fit the list?
items.description:
Hi, I run [DoableFromHome](https://doablefromhome.com), a remote tech job board that checks employer hiring restrictions against the country a job seeker selects.

I saw the contribution rule about paywalls and required login, so I wanted to check before opening a PR. Visitors can browse 20 jobs per search without an account. Free accounts get 40 jobs per search and saved searches. Full results and daily email alerts require Pro, and free users see new jobs 12 hours later.

The distinction is the country eligibility check: we assess employer location restrictions and explain the result for the reader's country. Listings link to the employer's posting.

Would a board with this access model be eligible for the Job boards section, or does the rule exclude it?
